//: mcp_servers.grafana entry for the Hermes chip profile (merge under mcp_servers in config.yaml; the lead integrates it into scripts/hermes/setup_profile.py). REPO is the repo root, filled in by the setup script. No secret here: the wrapper reads the Viewer token from the macOS Keychain (service open-ai-chip-grafana-mcp).

approvals_notes.why: Defence in depth: the server is started with -disable-write and an enabled-tools list of search, dashboard, datasource (so the write tools are not even registered), the Hermes tools.include list exposes only four tools, and the Grafana token is a Viewer service account (the API refuses writes). In Hermes approvals: mode manual stays; add the grafana write tool names above to approvals.deny, and let mcp_grafana read tools run without a prompt (they only read the local evidence database).
approvals_notes.limitation: mcp-grafana run_panel_query does not support the SQLite datasource and grafana_api_request (the only other way to run a panel query) is a generic request tool that is deliberately not enabled; so Hermes reads dashboard titles, panels and the panel SQL through Grafana and gets the numbers from the chip tools (read_metrics, compare_designs). Enabling grafana_api_request is an owner decision (Viewer token keeps it read-only at the Grafana side).
approvals_notes.hook: scripts/hermes/hooks/pre_tool_call.py needs no change for read tools; for belt and braces it may block any mcp tool whose name matches (update|create|delete|install|grafana_api_request|query_sql) when the server is grafana.
